visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a pink Pop Mart 'Crybaby Crying Again' blind box. A woman with dark hair and a white sweater holds the box, rotating it to show the different character designs on the side. The background is a brightly lit indoor living room with a yellow chair. (2) The woman and a young girl sit at a white table, tearing open silver foil bags with their hands. They look at the packages with wide eyes and smiles. The lighting is soft and even. (3) They reveal several plush keychains with oversized heads and tearful blue eyes. One character is wearing a bee costume, another is a baby in a diaper, and one looks like Alice in Wonderland. They hold the toys close to the camera, gesturing with excitement. (4) The duo displays all the unboxed plushies together, waving them toward the lens. The camera remains mostly static with some handheld jitter. A black screen with text appears at the end.
